use default
use Raster.IMAGE

class SANDPILE is
    _cells: LIST[int]

    size: int

    init(size: int) is
        self.size = size
        _cells = (0..size * size) |> map(_ => 0) |> collect_list()
    si

    at(x: int, y: int) -> int => _cells[y * size + x]

    add(x: int, y: int, grains: int) is
        _cells[y * size + x] = at(x, y) + grains
    si

    settle() is
        let unstable mut = true

        while unstable do
            unstable = false

            for y in 1..size - 1 do
                for x in 1..size - 1 do
                    if at(x, y) >= 4 then
                        let spilled = at(x, y) / 4

                        add(x, y, -4 * spilled)
                        add(x - 1, y, spilled)
                        add(x + 1, y, spilled)
                        add(x, y - 1, spilled)
                        add(x, y + 1, spilled)

                        unstable = true
                    fi
                od
            od
        od
    si
si

settled(size: int, grains: int) -> SANDPILE is
    let pile = SANDPILE(size)

    pile.add(size / 2, size / 2, grains)
    pile.settle()

    return pile
si

show(grains: int) is
    let pile = settled(5, grains)

    write_line("{grains} grains:")

    for y in 0..pile.size do
        write_line(
            "  {(0..pile.size) |> map(x => "{pile.at(x, y)}") |> join(" ")}"
        )
    od
si

let shades = [
    (red = 30ub, green = 30ub, blue = 60ub),
    (red = 70ub, green = 130ub, blue = 180ub),
    (red = 240ub, green = 200ub, blue = 80ub),
    (red = 200ub, green = 70ub, blue = 50ub)
]

show(4)
show(6)
show(16)

let big = settled(201, 20000)

let image = IMAGE(big.size, big.size)

for y in 0..big.size do
    for x in 0..big.size do
        let shade = shades[big.at(x, y)]

        image.set_pixel(x, y, shade.red, shade.green, shade.blue)
    od
od

image.write("sandpile.png")

image.show("sandpile.png")
